report.scope: Fix CR-009-1 (MEDIUM, docs/backlog/reviews/PBI-009/findings-r1.json) in worktree C:/Users/jdk/dispatch-board-worktrees/PBI-009, branch pbi/PBI-009-waiting-on-you, HEAD 8a59caa. Intent: is_owner_message() (exporters/derive.py:466) must not treat two Claude-Code-synthetic user records as the owner being present: a compaction summary (isCompactSummary true) and the fixed interruption-marker text Claude Code writes right after the owner rejects a tool-use prompt. Acceptance criteria (from the finding's remediation): (1) is_owner_message() rejects isCompactSummary:true records; (2) it rejects the fixed marker text '[Request interrupted by user for tool use]' as a narrow predicate exclusion, not a read of the refusal signal; (3) the docstring states why, without naming the finding/PBI; (4) regression tests cover a user-rejected denial surviving the marker, an automode-blocked denial surviving a compaction summary, a typed reply after either still clearing, and an Esc interruption with no refusal creating no item; (5) the builder's known-limit note that compaction clears items is removed wherever code or tests state it; (6) PARSER_VERSION stays at 8. Grounding path: ran-suite (all three canonical suites run from the worktree root); real transcript shapes for both synthetic record kinds were confirmed read-only under C:/Users/jdk/.claude/projects (no transcript content copied into fixtures beyond the fixed marker text and a paraphrased compaction-summary opening line).
